highlights: Retail 1 Growth Slowdown, Margins Impact Persists; Maintain HOLD Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – MISS; EBITDA – MISS Changes in Estimates post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: -3%/-4%; EBITDA: -25%/-30% Recommendation Rationale • Muted Revenue Growth: ABFRL reported 2.4% YoY revenue growth in Q2FY27, impacted by the shift in the festive calendar, with Durga Puja, pre-Diwali purchases and associated e- commerce sale events moving to Q3, alongside a subdued wedding season.

Additionally, 4–5% cost inflation, which Pantaloons has been unable to fully pass on through price hikes, is expected to result in an estimated 100bps gross margin impact as the inflationary impact fully sets in. • Management Outlook: Consumer demand remained steady, with better traction in lower-tier and rural markets despite festive shifts hurting Q2.
Early H2 trends are strong, with Onam and Durga Puja posting double-digit LTL growth and Diwali trending at mid-to-high single digits.
valuation: Result Update 09th November,2026 HOLD Target Price 40 Aditya Birla Fashion & Retail Ltd.

Current Valuation: 11xSep’28 EV/EBITDA (Earlier Valuation: 12xJun’28 EV/EBITDA) Current TP: Rs 40/share (Earlier TP: Rs 65/share) Recommendation: With a 0% upside from the CMP, we maintain our HOLD rating.

Meanwhile, the near-term textile cost inflation and discretionary demand volatility remain key monitorables, and hence, we adopt a “Wait and Watch” approach and maintain our HOLD rating on the stock with a revised TP of Rs 40/share, implying a 0% upside from the CMP.
